content.comment_body: Who can create a program command to remotely enable the target [product_name]'s upload mode for overwriting its program? I believe this is impossible unless someone is part of the [company_name] engineering team and knows the internal specifics.

analysis.insight_summary: A user is attempting to find a way to programmatically enable upload or overwrite mode ('open the door') on the [product_name] controller for remote updates. The discussion points out that this function may be restricted or unavailable for automated remote programming, indicating a limitation in the product's design.
analysis.user_expectations: The user would like to initiate upload/overwrite mode on the [product_name] controller remotely through a program command, hoping for functionality equivalent to manual local operations.
